cases.input: One requirement revision traces to three Done tasks and one failed test.
cases.expect: Requirement remains not verified and the failed result remains visible.

cases.input: A later test passes the same revision.
cases.expect: Pass may support satisfaction but does not erase the earlier failure.

cases.input: Tolerance changes after baseline B1 is sealed.
cases.expect: Issue a new requirement revision and baseline B2; B1 remains sealed and comparable.

cases.input: A test result for revision r1 is reused automatically for changed revision r2.
cases.expect: Rejected unless byte-identical scope is explicitly reaffirmed with evidence.

cases.input: A reusable formal rule is copied into many criteria.
cases.expect: Use one pinned WM-KNW-013 revision and local binding operands instead.

cases.input: Two requirement alternatives conflict and one is selected by decision.
cases.expect: Both alternatives and conflict remain; resolution references authority and selected revision.

cases.input: A sealed baseline set is edited in place.
cases.expect: Rejected; create a successor baseline with a new digest.
